debug.changelog:
feat: improve network resilience and update reliability

* feat: implement DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) fallback for system DNS lookups to improve connectivity in restricted environments
* fix: ensure non-Proton requests (such as OTA mirrors) include User-Agent and Accept headers to prevent 403/404 responses from hosting providers
* fix: add cache-busting timestamps to update metadata requests to bypass stale ISP or proxy caches
* refactor: improve `UpdateRepository` error handling by logging specific HTTP status codes and response bodies for easier debugging
